metadata.name: domWallet
metadata.description: (lock, names?) - the unsafe-wallet panel authored as a dom() formula (a showcase that interactive UI can be a formula). Compose it from the wallet's own readers: =domWallet(locked(walletNote), apiKeys()). Locked -> status + an unlock password box (wallet.unlock). Unlocked -> status + a lock button (wallet.lock) + a delete chip per key (wallet.del) + an add-a-key row (name -> wallet.newName, secret -> wallet.setNamed). Wires the SAME wallet.* handlers via on(); no new handlers, no secrets.

metadata.name: secrets
metadata.description: (lock, names?) - the Secrets panel: same re-backed rendering as domWallet (wires the SAME unsafe-wallet handlers), but with NO 'wallet' wording. Compose it reactively: =secrets(locked(secretsNote), apiKeys()). Locked -> status + an unlock password box. Unlocked -> a lock button + a key chip (✎ edit / ✕ delete) per stored key + an add-a-secret row (name -> wallet.newName, secret -> wallet.setNamed).

metadata.name: domClients
metadata.description: (claude, grok) - a read-only Clients panel. Pass the two client cells (clients.claude / clients.grok) so it re-fires when they (re)mint; each shows 🟢 ready (a captured client handle) or 🔒 locked (secrets locked). Reads CLIENT handles, never the key. =domClients(clients.claude, clients.grok)
